subject: Greenlane onboarding: invoice delivery & collection preferences
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Anna Ruiz <anna@greenlane.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-01T09:07:00Z
Subject: Invoice delivery & billing contact — onboarding question

Hi Anna,

Thanks for choosing Redwood — excited to get Greenlane live. Quick question on invoice delivery and payment collection so we can configure your account correctly before sending the first invoice:

- Do you prefer invoices posted to our billing portal (recommended for automated matching + XML) or direct PDF emailed to AP?
- If portal, please confirm primary AP email address for portal notifications (we can also auto-copy PDFs to an email of your choice).
- Will you need an XML/e-invoice (Peppol/SFTP) or is PDF sufficient?
- Please confirm Greenlane's VAT/Tax ID and the PO number you want on invoices.

I've attached the current invoice spec (Redwood-Invoice-Specs-v2.pdf) showing fields and sample PDF+XML layouts. If you prefer portal onboarding, we can create an account and invite your billing contact — onboarding typically takes 1–2 business days once we have the details and signed billing contact form.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Reply with AP email and VAT/Tax ID + sample PO (if available)
2) Tell us portal vs email preference and whether you need XML/JPG/SFTP
3) We'll send a short DocuSign to confirm billing contact and payment terms (Net 30 by default)

Thanks — copying Kim to help on the portal setup.

Best,
Monica Patel
Sr. Account Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0193

Attachment: Redwood-Invoice-Specs-v2.pdf (pdf)
From: Anna Ruiz <anna@greenlane.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Peter Smith <peter.smith@greenlane.com>
Date: 2028-03-02T14:32:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & billing contact — onboarding question

Thanks Monica — appreciate the clear breakdown. A few quick answers:

- Portal preferred for automated processing. We use an AP portal and would like the invoice posted there; however, we also need a PDF copy emailed to ap@greenlane.com for our internal archive.
- We do require an XML (UBL) export for our AP system; SFTP is not necessary if the portal provides XML download.
- VAT/Tax ID: GL-XX-123456.
- PO: attached Greenlane-PO-6789.pdf (please put PO on every invoice).

If you need a sample XML schema we currently accept, I can ask our AP team to send one. For now, please proceed with portal onboarding and email copies to ap@greenlane.com.

Best,
Anna Ruiz
Head of Finance Operations, Greenlane Logistics
anna@greenlane.com
+1 212-555-0167

Attachment: Greenlane-PO-6789.pdf (pdf)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Anna Ruiz <anna@greenlane.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-03T10:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & billing contact — onboarding question

Hi Anna — thanks for the quick reply and the PO. A few operational details from our side to make sure we set everything correctly: 

- Invoice format: we will publish invoices to the Redwood billing portal and attach a PDF copy to ap@greenlane.com for archiving. We can also generate a UBL/XML file matching the sample fields in the attached spec. If you have a sample XML schema, please send it to ensure field mapping.
- PO placement: we'll include the PO number in the invoice header and line references.
- Tax/VAT: we'll show VAT as a line item. Confirm whether Greenlane wants VAT shown as separate lines per line item or one consolidated VAT line on the summary.
- Bank/payment: Our standard payment term is Net 30 ACH/Wire. If Greenlane requires different terms or a different remittance format, flag it now so it's reflected in the billing portal.

Action items for Greenlane (please reply inline):
1) Confirm portal invite email (we will invite ap@greenlane.com unless you want a different address).
2) Confirm XML schema or accept Redwood's default XML (our spec attached).
3) Confirm VAT line preference (per line item vs consolidated).

I'll start the portal invite as soon as we get confirmation on the three items. Monica will follow up with the DocuSign for the billing contact authorization.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Billing Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Anna Ruiz <anna@greenlane.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-05T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & billing contact — onboarding question

Hi Anna — great, thanks for confirming. Finalizing next steps so we can turn this on next week: 

1) Portal invite: We'll invite ap@greenlane.com to the Redwood billing portal (portal will expose PDF + XML downloads). Expected onboarding time: 1 business day after invite is accepted.
2) VAT display: we'll default to a consolidated VAT line on the invoice summary unless you confirm per-line VAT by EOD Friday.
3) PO: we'll put Greenlane-PO-6789 on all invoices.
4) DocuSign: sending a short billing contact authorization form now (link: https://app.redwood.com/docusign/GL-BILLING-4521). Please have your AP or authorized signer complete to enable portal admin access.

We will create a sample invoice (PDF + XML) and send it to ap@greenlane.com and to you for confirmation before the first real invoice goes out. If everything looks good we'll mark the account live and include Net 30 payment terms.

If anything needs changing (different remittance or payment terms), let us know. Otherwise we'll proceed with the portal + email copy flow described.

Best,
Monica Patel
Sr. Account Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0193
